name: abap-lsp
description: Language Server Protocol implementation for ABAP

commands.title: ABAP LSP: Create Linked ABAP Project
ABAP LSP: Add Local ABAP Source File
ABAP LSP: Initialize Workspace From ADT Object
ABAP LSP: Add Editable ADT Object to Workspace
ABAP LSP: Create Local-First Workspace Manifest

abap-ls.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Controls the maximum number of problems produced by the server.

abap-ls.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

abap-ls.serverTransport.description: How the extension connects to the language server: spawn abap-ls.serverExecutable and speak LSP over stdio (production), or connect to an already-running server over TCP (development / debugging).

abap-ls.serverExecutable.description: Path to the abap_lsp_server binary when serverTransport is "stdio". Overrides are: environment variables __ABAP_LSP_SERVER_PATH or __ABAP_LSP_SERVER_DEBUG.

abap-ls.serverTcpAddress.description: host:port when serverTransport is "tcp" (or when __ABAP_LSP_CONNECT is set). Start the server with e.g. abap_lsp_server --listen 127.0.0.1:9472 or ABAP_LSP_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:9472.

abap-ls.sap.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the SAP system used for ADT requests, for example https://host.example.com.

abap-ls.sap.username.description: SAP username used for ADT requests. Password is stored securely in VS Code secret storage.

abap-ls.sap.localDependencyRoots.description: Local exported ABAP package roots to search before live ADT fetches when resolving remote dependencies.
